insight.headline: New fields for cash
insight.what_changed: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. The CashDrawerBalance field and CashCountActivity field are now available. These fields provide more information about the cash management activities and balances.
insight.developer_impact: Developers can now use these new fields to fetch more detailed information about cash management activities and balances. They can use the GraphQL Admin API to query these fields and build more informative and functional apps for merchants. For example, they can use the CashDrawerBalance field to display the current balance of a cash drawer or use the CashCountActivity field to track cash count activities. When using the GraphQL Admin API, developers should ensure they are using the correct API version, which is 2026-10 or later, to access these new fields.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will have more detailed information about their cash management activities and balances, which can help them make more informed decisions about their business. They will be able to track their cash drawer balances and cash count activities more accurately.
insight.why_it_matters: These new fields provide more detailed information about cash management activities and balances, which can help developers build more functional and informative apps for merchants. This can lead to better decision-making and more efficient cash management for merchants.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefront capabilities and developer tools

themes.title: Storefront Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP tools are available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores. This update also includes the ability to update cart attributes and fire events when attributes are updated.

themes.title: Developer Tools and Infrastructure
themes.detail: The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which includes serving UI extension source maps during app development. Additionally, Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing for the deployment of Hydrogen storefronts.
